facts.fact: Corporate Castle is a glass-walled tech kingdom powered by Slack-runes, Zoom lairs, and The Equity Vault. Two spires rise above its courtyard across a moat: the Tower of Vibes (home to the Courtiers of Optics, Human Capital partners pampering the High Lords of Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Service) and Liability Tower (home to the Counsel of Liability). Far beneath the Tower of Vibes sits the ER Dungeon, home to the Employee Relations Watch (ER Watch) and the ER Vault.

Deep Magic (Spirit: Truth & Justice), practiced by Marissa and the ER Watch (and respected by High Lady Lexi), is grounded in unvarnished truth, objective fact-finding, evidentiary clarity, and applying The Codex equally to frontline guild members and High Lords alike.
facts.provenance: Google Doc 1HW7Fu6Ug32OM7qx7lF1E63ePWXa_6iTr3MPqXo0T3MY, Tab 4 (t.k04gx9f8116z) Section 2 (The Two-Magic System), 2026-11-25

facts.fact: The Counsel of Liability practices an equally legitimate branch of Deep Magic focused on statutory counsel, legal risk analysis, and insulating the realm from subpoenas and regulatory fire (Cold Alchemy is removed). Nothing is inherently wrong with Liability's discipline—Sir Leo practices it with candor (alongside his own personal foibles to be explored later). Doctor Lois's collapse whenever Deep Magic must point upward at a High Lord is strictly a personal failure of courage, not a flaw in Liability's craft.
facts.provenance: Google Doc Tab 4 refined by author ruling DEC-CC-0007, 2026-11-26

facts.fact: Illusion Magic is the discipline of lavender-scented jargon, corporate theater, executive revisionism, and hollow remedies (such as coaching or retroactive titles) used by the Courtiers of Optics—and by Doctor Lois when bending to politics or cornered—to mask institutional rot and preserve optics. High Lady Lexi also used a clean feat of Illusion Magic to vanish upon resigning.

The Mirror Shield is Marissa's signature Deep Magic technique: pure, unblinking stillness paired with surgical, unspinnable truth, offering an opponent zero venting, soothing, or deference so that political evasion and botched Illusion Magic rebound directly onto the caster.
facts.provenance: Google Doc 1HW7Fu6Ug32OM7qx7lF1E63ePWXa_6iTr3MPqXo0T3MY, Tab 4 (t.k04gx9f8116z) Section 2 (The Two-Magic System), 2026-11-25

facts.fact: No Coercion (The Two-Way Law of Free Will): Neither Deep Magic nor the towers can override free will. The ER Watch cannot force a Warlord or High Lord to act justly—only warn, shield, and expose. Equally, employees possess free will and can walk out Corporate Castle's gates on their own terms, taking their HR Lore with them.
facts.provenance: Google Doc 1HW7Fu6Ug32OM7qx7lF1E63ePWXa_6iTr3MPqXo0T3MY, Tab 1 (t.371ksllamqpd) Hard Rules of Magic, reconciled with Tab 4, 2026-11-25

facts.fact: Unwritten Magic Evaporates: Verbal warnings, coaching, and off-the-record legal advice dissolve by sundown unless bound into ink (such as via The Ink-Bind or Vault-Sealing).
facts.provenance: Google Doc 1HW7Fu6Ug32OM7qx7lF1E63ePWXa_6iTr3MPqXo0T3MY, Tab 1 (t.371ksllamqpd) Hard Rules of Magic, 2026-11-25

facts.fact: The Book Isn't the Gift: Possessing the Spellbooks of Deep Magic or inheriting the keys to the ER Vault does not grant True-Sight or HR Lore.
facts.provenance: Google Doc 1HW7Fu6Ug32OM7qx7lF1E63ePWXa_6iTr3MPqXo0T3MY, Tab 1 (t.371ksllamqpd) Hard Rules of Magic, 2026-11-25

facts.fact: Marissa, Royal Inquisitor, is a sharp, licensed practitioner of Deep Magic who owns Corporate Castle's highest-stakes Formal Inquiries into Crimes Against the Codex (discrimination, harassment, and Crown-Level landmines) with all exhibits sealed inside the ER Vault, and also serves as reluctant translator and referee between Liability Tower and the Courtiers of Optics on messy High Lord reorgs, Headcount Pruning, and High Lord Okta Excommunications.

Sarai, Captain of the ER Watch, leads the ER Squires—Riley and Victoria—who hold the frontline line between trigger-happy Warlords and employees across Trials by PIP, Writs of Warning, and daily workplace skirmishes.

High Lady Lexi of Vibe Operations originally rose from the ER Watch and climbed the High Lord path as additional orgs were piled onto her crest until her ER title faded beneath Vibe Operations. She maintained a protective ward between the ER Dungeon and the Tower of Vibes while Marissa and Sarai carried the Watch below.
facts.provenance: Google Doc 1HW7Fu6Ug32OM7qx7lF1E63ePWXa_6iTr3MPqXo0T3MY, Tab 4 (t.k04gx9f8116z) Locked Prologue & Section 3, 2026-11-25

facts.fact: As the years passed, standing so close to the upper court's politics proved intolerable to anyone with even a spark of Deep Magic. Disgusted at last, High Lady Lexi decided she had served the Court long enough. One autumn evening she secured a private Offline Oath from Doctor Lois, Grand Archivist of Liability, to shelter the ER Watch if the Courtiers panicked, descended to the ER Dungeon to say goodbye to Marissa and Sarai, and vanished the next morning without leaving the upper floors a farewell Slack-rune. (No explicit mention of a King or hidden throne secret in the Prologue per DEC-CC-0005.)
facts.provenance: Google Doc Tab 4 reconciled with author ruling DEC-CC-0005, 2026-11-25

facts.fact: After Lexi's sudden departure left a leadership vacuum in the Tower of Vibes—where not a single Courtier spoke a word of Deep Magic—Doctor Lois was caught between her Offline Oath to Lexi and a Royal Volun-telling from Lord Sterling and was in no position to refuse. Expecting a brief loan of a quarter at most, Lois watched Sterling rebrand the punt as a 'temporary cross-tower experiment' and kick the ER Watch across the moat to Liability Tower without a single gold coin of budget. Left to fend for themselves, Marissa and Sarai found an abandoned wooden barge moored outside Liability Tower's drawbridge and moved the Watch aboard without Lois's help.

Doctor Lois's singular, consistent defining flaw is that she will never spend her own political capital to defend the truth—using Deep Magic to mask fear and cowardice, exposing her as a hidden High Lord of Vibes hiding behind her glowing red pen who ultimately tries and fails to use Illusion Magic on Marissa.
facts.provenance: Google Doc Tab 4 refined by author rulings 2026-11-25 and 2026-11-26 (`DEC-CC-0008`)

facts.fact: Sir Leo, Counsel of Liability, is a knight of Deep Magic and far more learned in the intricacies of its spells than Doctor Lois. He shows what Liability should be when wielded properly—dry wit, candor, genuine respect for Marissa as a fellow licensed practitioner, and willingness to go to bat and take the hit for her when it counts—balanced by human foibles: venting out-of-touch complaints about Lois's coldness from inside Liability Tower while knowing Marissa carries heavy weight even for him and quietly taking advantage of it (the unspoken tax of his allyship).
